title: Tidewater Sync 4.2 Release Notes
key_sentences: Tidewater Sync 4.2 is a feature release that adds scheduled two-way synchronisation for object stores and retires the legacy XML job format.
Existing 4.x installations can be upgraded in place once their job files have been converted.
Job files written in the XML format must be converted before the agent is restarted.
The following keys are new or have changed default values in this release.
Two-way synchronisation does not yet preserve custom metadata on Azure Blob targets.

rows: Interval between two runs of the job. Accepts units m, h and d.
Quiet window in local time during which no new transfer starts.
Enables two-way synchronisation for the target.
What to do when both sides changed: keep-both, prefer-source or prefer-target.
Number of retries for a failed transfer before the job is marked as failed.
Delay strategy between retries: linear or exponential.
Size of the parts used for resumable uploads.

list_items.text: Two-way synchronisation for S3-compatible and Azure Blob targets, with conflict detection based on object version identifiers.
A scheduler built into the agent, so external cron entries are no longer required.
intervals from one minute to seven days
optional quiet windows during which no transfers start
Resumable transfers for files larger than 4 GB.
A new validate command that checks job files without contacting any target.
Stop all running jobs and wait until the agent reports an idle state.
Back up the configuration directory, including:
Install the 4.2 package over the existing installation.
– The XML job format is no longer read by the agent.
– The --legacy-auth option has been removed; use access keys or managed identities instead.
– The Windows Server 2016 package is deprecated and will not be built after version 4.4.

code:
$ tidewater-sync convert --from xml --to yaml jobs/*.xml
$ tidewater-sync validate jobs/
$ tidewater-sync agent restart

schedule:
  every: 15m
  window: "22:00-06:00"
targets:
  - name: archive-eu
    type: s3
    bucket: tw-archive-eu
    two_way: true
retry:
  attempts: 5
  backoff: exponential
